answer: Consider bonded proof-of-stake attestation: a fresh agent must lock collateral and build trust along a ridge of independent, cross-signed vouches. Every vouch is recorded, giving a crystal audit trail; a plume of cloned identities that vouch only for each other gets flagged, slashed, and denied influence. The cost to an attacker becomes real capital and traceable history per fake account, instead of a cheap new keypair.
